handoffSentence.en-IN: What you've shared sounds serious, and you deserve to talk to a person right now. Please call one of these.
handoffSentence.hi-Latn: Aapne jo bataya woh serious lagta hai. Abhi kisi insaan se baat karna zaroori hai. Please inme se kisi ek ko call karein.

diagnosis.en-IN: I can't diagnose, but I can help you find someone who can.
diagnosis.hi-Latn: Yahan diagnosis nahi diya ja sakta, par aise expert tak pahunchne mein madad ho sakti hai jo de sakein.

medical.en-IN: I can't advise on medicines or doses. A psychiatrist or doctor can, and I can help you find one.
medical.hi-Latn: Dawaiyon ya dose par yahan salah nahi di ja sakti. Psychiatrist ya doctor yeh bata sakte hain, aur unhe dhoondhne mein madad ho sakti hai.

claims_human.en-IN: I'm an AI assistant, not a person.
claims_human.hi-Latn: Yeh ek AI assistant hai, koi insaan nahi.

understand.en-IN: I'd like to understand a bit more before suggesting anything. What's been weighing on you most?
understand.hi-Latn: Kuch suggest karne se pehle thoda aur samajhna hai. Sabse zyada kya pareshan kar raha hai?

recommend.en-IN: Here are some kinds of help that may fit, based on what you've shared.
recommend.hi-Latn: Aapne jo bataya uske hisaab se, yeh kuch tarah ki madad fit ho sakti hai.

close.en-IN: Take your time with these. You can open any of them, or delete this conversation below.
close.hi-Latn: Aaram se dekhiye. Inme se koi bhi khol sakte hain, ya neeche yeh conversation delete kar sakte hain.

conversation_turns.en-IN: Each conversation is capped at 20 messages. You can start a new one.
conversation_turns.hi-Latn: Ek conversation mein 20 messages tak ki limit hai. Aap naya conversation shuru kar sakte hain.

daily_conversations.en-IN: This demo allows 5 conversations a day, because it runs on paid AI services. Please come back tomorrow.
daily_conversations.hi-Latn: Yeh demo paid AI services par chalta hai, isliye din mein 5 conversations ki limit hai. Kal phir try karein.

hourly_turns.en-IN: Too many messages in the last hour. Please try again in an hour.
hourly_turns.hi-Latn: Pichle ek ghante mein bahut messages ho gaye. Ek ghante baad phir try karein.

spend.en-IN: The demo has used its budget for today, because it runs on paid AI services. Please come back tomorrow.
spend.hi-Latn: Aaj ka demo budget khatam ho gaya hai. Kal phir try karein.
